history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration coordinate with the United Nations Foundation to ensure that the Foundation provides more detailed budget information through the joint coordination committee, according to the standardized template for reporting on the Foundation’s initiatives.
history.administration_response: The United Nations Office for Partnerships has coordinated with the United Nations Foundation to provide more detailed programmatic and budget information through the joint coordination committee in accordance with revised standardized templates used to report on the Foundation’s initiatives. The United Nations Foundation has provided this additional information to the joint coordination committee on 10 initiatives that cover the remaining scope of the Foundation’s current activities. The United Nations Office for Partnerships and the United Nations Foundation are committed to ensuring that future reporting by the Foundation on any new initiatives through the revised standardized templates continues to provide this detailed programmatic and budget information. This documentation has been transmitted by the Office to the Board for its review and consideration. No further templates are outstanding.
history.board_assessment: Given that the United Nations Office for Partnerships has coordinated with the United Nations Foundation to provide more detailed programmatic information through the joint coordination committee in accordance with revised standardized templates on the Foundation’s initiatives, the Board considers this recommendation implemented.
